_comment: Prebuilt-binary manifest for lib.sh:download_bins() / join.sh. baseUrl + file (with {os}/{arch} substituted) form the download URL; archive says how to unpack it; produces maps a logical binary name to its path *inside* the download ("" = the download IS the binary, "." = the whole extracted directory is the product, e.g. a dist dir). platforms uses {os}-{arch} keys (darwin|linux, amd64|arm64); "*" = platform-independent. sha256 keys mirror platforms (or "*"), fetched from the upstream <file>.sha256 siblings on xdc.network. Re-run the fetch and bump 'updated' if xdc.network publishes new binaries. A client entry may set its own "baseUrl" to override this global one (e.g. to pull an urgent fix from a GitHub release before it's mirrored to xdc.network) -- see lib.sh:_binjson_query.

oldxdc._comment: XDPoSChain (XDCIndia/OLDXDC), the legacy sealer client run.sh/setup.sh use by default. Previously ALWAYS built from source (lib.sh hardcoded this regardless of BIN_SOURCE) since no prebuilt existed anywhere -- every `run.sh --chainid N` / `setup.sh --new` clone+built from scratch even for a plain resume, adding minutes before any node came up. Published this tarball (XDC + bootnode + puppeth, linux-amd64) from XDCIndia/OLDXDC's pinned commit 0648a96a22affcc0b4dd2201614a118b084fe7bf (the 'XDPoSChain codebase snapshot with puppeth wizard genesis fix' XDPOS_REPO already points at) so lib.sh:download_bins() has something to fetch. Now respects BIN_SOURCE/BIN_SOURCE_oldxdc like every other client: download by default, `--build` (run.sh/setup.sh) or BIN_SOURCE_oldxdc=build forces a from-source clone+build instead. darwin/other-arch prebuilts not published yet -- falls back to a source build there same as before.

geth._comment: darwin-amd64/darwin-arm64 are the SAME universal (lipo fat) binary -- identical sha256 under both filenames, runs natively on either Mac architecture. Built 2026-07-30 from main at commit f39bb0769d0c142a1d50d34476055c4b9b1caaf3, self-reporting Version 1.17.5-xdc.8. Verified via `lipo -info` (x86_64 + arm64 slices both present) and by downloading the published file and running `geth version`. NOTE: geth here is NOT pure Go -- it pulls in cgo (secp256k1, usb), so the amd64 slice cannot be cross-compiled with GOARCH alone: its Makefile wraps `go run build/ci.go install`, which honours ci.go's own -arch flag and ignores GOARCH. Passing GOARCH=amd64 silently produced an arm64 slice and lipo then refused the pair. See publish-bins.sh build_pure_go_client.

geth1175._comment: geth 1.17.5-xdc.8, published as a SEPARATE artefact so the default `geth` entry (1.17.4-xdc.7) is untouched -- opt in with `--client geth1175`. linux-amd64 only: darwin/arm64 have not been built or validated for this version, and shipping unverified cross-compiles is how a stalling reth binary shipped for a week (see #119). Validated on netv12 (chainId 34093): 9-client x 6-height x 7-field parity as a follower incl. the legacy XDPoSChain v2.7.1 validators, then runtime-onboarded as a validator and gate-proven minting 238/2140 = 11.12% against an 11.11% ideal over 2.38 epochs with max_seal_gap=9 (never missed a turn), signers ecrecovered from the M1 seal and attributed by three independent validators with its own RPC excluded. See #124.

erigon._comment: linux-amd64 + darwin (universal) published. darwin-amd64/darwin-arm64 are the SAME lipo fat binary built 2026-07-24 from main (arm64 native + amd64 cross-compiled with CGO_ENABLED=1 CC/CXX=clang -arch x86_64, needed since erigon uses cgo for mdbx/blst/evmone) -- includes the node/cli p2p.allowed-ports flag-registration fix (PR XDCIndia/erigon-xdc#361, pending human merge). --chain xdc-net5151 genesis 0x96f121 verified on the arm64 slice + live-synced past block 20000. Other platforms fall back to a source build (lib.sh).

reth._comment: darwin-amd64/darwin-arm64 are now the SAME universal (lipo fat) binary built 2026-07-24 from main, which now includes the #12 chain-recognition fix (PR XDCIndia/reth#253, merged) — genesis-config-driven XDC detection, verified live-syncing net5151 (3 peers, block import, no Ethereum-bootnode fallback) on the arm64 slice. amd64 cross-compiled via `rustup target add x86_64-apple-darwin --toolchain stable` (default toolchain here is a pre-2024-edition nightly; must use stable). Other platforms unchanged.

besu._comment: Java, platform-independent — now SELF-CONTAINED: the archive bundles a Temurin JRE 21 (real conf/security, not the Ubuntu-JDK /etc symlink) under jre/ and the bin/besu launcher is patched to use $APP_HOME/jre, so NO host Java is required (the previous dist needed host Java >=21). Archive contains bin/besu (launcher) + jre/ (bundled runtime) + lib/*.jar. Built on the 7ade4f2f v00.0-develop base (net5151-working; supersedes the broken v26.7 246e5030 that failed net5151 block-1, see ItWorksinMyLocal #51). Public mainnet/apothem still need the client-side fork-id fix (issue #69) to peer; net5151 syncs.

nethermind._comment: No linux-arm64 build published. Archive is a flat .NET publish dir (./nethermind launcher + ./chainspec/*.json + ./configs/*.json at the archive root, no version-prefixed top dir), so produces path is '.' (the whole extracted dir is NETHERMIND_DIST). This archive INCLUDES chainspec/xdc-devnet5151.json (chainId 5151, genesis 0x96f121, XDPoS engine) and its runner config, so join.sh --client nethermind syncs devnet 5151 out of the box. Built from XDCIndia/xdc-nethermind-private with the net5151 follower bypass (PR #246): the legacy chain's non-standard gas schedule can't be recomputed bit-for-bit, so for chainId 5151 the header's gas-derived fields are trusted while state is fully validated -- linux-amd64 verified syncing to the live tip. NOTE: darwin-arm64 refreshed 2026-07-23 (built from main, v1.36.0) but NOT sync-verified (host disk below the 47GB HealthChecks guard) and may be missing chainspec/xdc-devnet5151.json (absent from main at build time); linux-amd64 remains the verified 5151 client -- see issue #32.

xone._comment: xone-native (XDCIndia/xOneGo), the go-ethereum-derived XDPoS reference client (built from pkg/cmd/xone-native; the `xone` binary is only a launcher). NOTE: use `xone --version` (not the `version` subcommand, which boots a node). [ItWorksinMyLocal#114: v1.1.0 (b117fbd7) computes a DIFFERENT genesis hash than geth/oldxdc/erigon/besu/reth for the same genesis.json -- confirmed empirically byte-for-byte identical extraData/stateRoot/timestamp/etc, only the final header hash diverges, so this is a client-side hashing difference, not a genesis-format one. Fixed by the 'v-xdc-xone-mint-20260725' release (commit 695d3d0a, PR XDCIndia/xOneGo#690, built on top of the v1.2.0 tag) -- verified live-computing the SAME genesis hash as geth/oldxdc/erigon/besu/reth for two independent local setup.sh genesis files, and this is the exact build chain 34093's live xone follower/validators run. IMPORTANT: a plain `go build -tags goethkzg ./cmd/xone-native` at this exact commit does NOT reproduce this -- it builds successfully but computes yet a THIRD, different genesis hash, so the fix is pinned to these exact release bytes (sha256 below), not 'build commit 695d3d0a' as a recipe. xOneGo is a PRIVATE repo, so this asset is fetched via `gh release download` (see ghRelease below + lib.sh:download_bins), not a plain curl URL -- requires a `gh` CLI authenticated against XDCIndia's org. darwin-amd64/darwin-arm64 are NOT yet republished from this fix (still the old v1.1.0 universal binary as of 2026-07-24) -- dropped from platforms below rather than silently serving a binary known to diverge on genesis hash; follow up to publish this same release asset to xdc.network (the normal distribution path every other client here uses) and restore darwin once a universal build exists, so contributors without gh/private-repo access can still fetch it.]
